hindi_voice_text: तीरों की बरसात। धनुर्धर अटल रहा।
english_voice_text: A rain of arrows. The archer never moved.
hinglish_screen_text: Teeron ki barsaat. Dhanurdhar atal raha.
note: Hindi shortened: the archer stands firm, in two short beats instead of three.

hindi_voice_text: चर का पहला वार — और सेनापति गिरा!
english_voice_text: The Chara struck first — and a commander fell!
hinglish_screen_text: Chara ka pehla vaar — aur senapati gira!
note: Hindi shortened: the strike lands at once; dropped the extra words.

hindi_voice_text: यंत्रिक ने जाल बेकार कर दिया। रास्ता साफ़ है।
english_voice_text: The Yantrik clears the trap. The lane is open.
hinglish_screen_text: Yantrik ne jaal bekaar kar diya. Raasta saaf hai.
note: English shortened: "clears the trap" replaces "takes the trap apart".

hindi_voice_text: कमल घूम गया, महाराज। राज़ खुल गए।
english_voice_text: The lotus turns, Maharaj. Its secrets open.
hinglish_screen_text: Kamal ghoom gaya, Maharaj. Raaz khul gaye.
note: English and Hindi shortened: the petals are implied by the lotus; the secrets line is one beat.

hindi_voice_text: वायव्यास्त्र — दो मोहरे जगह बदल गए। दोबारा परखिए।
english_voice_text: They called the wind. Two pieces traded places — check them again.
hinglish_screen_text: Vayavyastra — do mohre jagah badal gaye. Dobara parkhiye.
note: Not in the four: measured 6.14 s (English) and 5.62 s (Hindi) at pace 1.15, the longest line in the game. Shortened, re-recorded, now 3.92 s / 3.92 s.

hindi_voice_text: एक मोहरा गया, महाराज। वो हमसे भारी था।
english_voice_text: We lost one, Maharaj. They were stronger than they looked.
hinglish_screen_text: Ek mohra gaya, Maharaj. Woh humse bhaari tha.
note: Not in the four: this routine clash line re-recorded at 4.23 s and broke the 5.0 s Calm budget for a routine line (pace-budget --strict). Hindi shortened and re-recorded, now 2.59 s.
